login.title: Sign in
login.notice: Sign-in is turned off in this environment (ADMIN_AUTH_MODE=disabled).
login.noticeNotConfigured: Sign-in is enabled, but the Supabase URL or public key is not configured. Contact the technical lead.

errors.email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email before signing in (check the message we sent you).
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

notices.password_changed: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your account email. If it exists, we'll send you a link to create a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a link to create a new password. Check your inbox (and spam). The link expires soon and can only be used once.
forgotPassword.linkInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new link below.
forgotPassword.unavailable: Password reset is not available in this environment.

errors.not_configured: Password reset is not configured in this environment.

newPassword.title: New password
newPassword.hint: At least 8 characters. Accents and emojis take more space: the total limit is 72 bytes.

errors.invalid_input: Fill in the new password and the confirmation.
errors.password_too_short: The password must have at least 8 characters.
errors.password_too_long: The password is too long (72-byte limit — accents and emojis count more). Use a shorter password.
errors.weak_password: This password is too weak. Choose another one.
errors.same_password: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.session_expired: The time to change your password has run out. Request a new link.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.not_configured: Password reset is not configured in this environment.
errors.unknown: We couldn't save your new password. Please try again shortly.
